metadata.title: Tropical Still Life with Monobloc Chairs

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-angle medium shot featuring two white plastic monobloc chairs placed on patchy grass in front of a dense thicket of banana trees. A large bunch of green, unripe bananas hangs prominently in the upper center, serving as a secondary focal point above the chairs. The scene is characterized by a mix of vibrant green living leaves and brown, withered banana fronds, creating a texture-rich, naturalistic environment.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the synthetic white plastic of the chairs and the organic textures of the foliage.
Vertical alignment of the banana bunch directly above the space between the two chairs.
Juxtaposition of the upright, functional chairs against the chaotic, sprawling growth of the tropical grove.
coreInvariants: A bunch of green bananas hanging from a tree
A background of large, overlapping tropical leaves

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The two chairs occupy the lower third of the frame, scaled to appear as the primary subjects. The banana bunch is positioned in the upper-middle section.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white chair on the left acts as the primary visual anchor due to its high contrast against the dark green background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the white chairs, moves upward to the green banana bunch, and then scans the surrounding dense foliage and dried leaves.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the frame is densely packed with vegetation, creating a sense of enclosure.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep forest greens and earthy browns from the banana trees and ground.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright, stark white from the plastic chairs.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant lime green from the unripe bananas.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the chairs and the background; medium saturation in the greens with muted, desaturated tones in the dried brown leaves.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or artificial colors outside of the white chairs

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dense tropical scene featuring banana trees with large green leaves and hanging brown dried fronds. In the center, include a bunch of unripe green bananas hanging from a stem. The ground should be patchy grass and dirt.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place two white plastic monobloc chairs in the foreground, one slightly angled, ensuring they look weathered and integrated into the lighting of the scene.

verificationChecks: Are there two distinct white chairs?
Is the banana bunch green and unripe?
Is the background a mix of healthy green and dead brown leaves?
Is the lighting natural and diffused?

mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on the chairs
Modern urban elements in the background

mustAchieve: Realistic texture on the banana leaves
Correct plastic sheen on the chairs
Depth of field that keeps both chairs and bananas in focus

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic shadows under the chairs.
Ensure the banana bunch looks heavy and naturally attached.
Verify the texture of the dried leaves is brittle and brown.
Confirm the chairs are the only non-organic elements.
recipe.reuseFormula: Place [synthetic everyday objects] in a [dense, unmanicured tropical environment] featuring [specific fruit-bearing plant] to create a contrast between [human utility] and [wild growth].
